opportunities.title: Junior Scientist Conference Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Undergraduate, Master’s and PhD student members and postdoctoral members within six years of PhD viva (Scheme A); PhD students and postdocs within six years for Schemes B & C; UK‑based members for conferences outside the UK and non‑UK members for UK conferences.
opportunities.summary: Supports attendance of Genetics Society junior scientist members at conferences (Society meetings, SIG meetings, non‑Society meetings, and virtual conferences).

opportunities.title: Training Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All Genetics Society members who are studying or working in the UK, or whose course is in the UK; students need a supervisor letter; members should have been Society members for at least one year.
opportunities.summary: Grants up to £1,200 to enable members to attend short training courses or collaborative visits for genetics/genomic techniques.

opportunities.title: Heredity Fieldwork Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All Genetics Society members studying or working in the UK, or intending to carry out fieldwork in the UK; supervisors must be Society members; one grant per research group per 12 months; one grant per applicant per 2 years.
opportunities.summary: Covers travel, accommodation, subsistence and limited equipment for field‑based genetic research projects suitable for publication in the journal Heredity.

opportunities.title: One‑off Meeting Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of the Genetics Society proposing to sponsor a genetics‑themed meeting not organized by the Society; meeting should be UK‑based or strongly linked to the UK.
opportunities.summary: Sponsorship for ad‑hoc genetics meetings, covering venue, travel, accommodation and optional Carer’s Award.

opportunities.title: Public Engagement Grant
opportunities.summary: Grants up to £1,000 to support public engagement activities related to genetics, covering travel and materials costs.

opportunities.title: Special Interest Group Funding
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Groups applying to become a new Special Interest Group; meetings should be UK‑based or strongly linked to the UK; applications submitted at least three months before the first meeting.
opportunities.summary: Funding to sponsor regular series of meetings on specific genetics themes, up to £2,000 per year.

opportunities.title: Carer’s Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any Genetics Society member caring for another person.
opportunities.summary: Award of up to £60 per day to support attendance at Society meetings for members with caring responsibilities.
